verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs describe automations that speed month-end bookkeeping: receipt capture, real-time expense categorization, and automatic sync of detailed transaction data to QuickBooks Online and Xero. However, nothing in the evidence says any of this is AI-driven, and nothing describes a reconciliation or month-end close workflow. missing for 10: any evidence that the automations use AI (e.g., AI categorization or matching), documented reconciliation or close features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of faster book closing.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI automations to close my books faster each month

citations.quote: Capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync everything to your accounting software automatically.
Relay syncs ultra-detailed, easy-to-understand transaction data directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero.
